t: A prayer for the sick with a reason attached
a: اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ عَبْدَكَ يَنْكَأُ لَكَ عَدُوًّا أَوْ يَمْشِي لَكَ إِلَى جَنَازَةٍ
p: Allāhumma-shfi ʿabdaka yankaʾu laka ʿaduwwan aw yamshī laka ilā janāzah
m: O Allah, heal Your servant, that he may wound an enemy for You, or walk to a funeral for You.
